newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle lightly traded at $71 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle lightly traded at $71 - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow. Slaughter steers and heifers firm, but not well established. Inquiry and demand good.

Sales confirmed on 400 slaughter steers and 400 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 69,200 head confirmed including 11,700 head or about 17 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Week to date: 69200 Last week: 49600 Last year: 66900
Slaughter steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1315 lbs 71.00.
Slaughter heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1200 lbs 71.00.
